verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The prior major finding is resolved soundly. Recovery for `worker-no-change` now requires every row in the hysteresis window to carry a numeric rate backed by at least `worker_min_samples`; null telemetry therefore leaves a live alert open. The added tests establish both sides non-vacuously: an all-null recovery window does not recover, while an otherwise identical measured-clear window does, and unrelated measured classes remain recoverable. I found no new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff.
